placements.why: The content is about pipeline behavior — how the system must handle a missing identity field by generating a slug. This is an architectural design decision about pipeline responsibility, warranting a top-level organizational category for system/pipeline architecture that starts empty and will grow.
placements.title: system and pipeline design decisions
placements.frame: What design obligations does the system impose on itself for how its pipelines must behave?

placements.title: absence of identity triggers generative or deterministic slug production
placements.frame: What does the pipeline owe a submission that arrives without identity, and which generative or deterministic paths fulfill that obligation?
placements.why: src-1 asserts the condition — a submission without an explicit id field; src-2 states the mandated remedy — the pipeline must produce a slug from memory content via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback, then commit the file. Together they form a thematic arc about the system's responsibility to generate identity from content when none is provided, a subject future envelopes can keep feeding (other fallback behaviors, other identity-generation paths, other pipeline obligations). No existing leaf or strata holds this — both tiers start empty — so it is a genuine mint.
